description: This is a Java service class named UserService responsible for handling user-related operations such as retrieving user information by identification number and fetching paginated lists of users within a finance/internet banking application.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class providing user-related business logic, including retrieval of user data by identification and paginated user listing.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User DTO based on the identification number, throwing EntityNotFoundException if no user is found.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of User DTOs with pagination support.
